scope: Independent reconstruction of one completed UI campaign, not a new campaign sample, strategy benchmark, counterfactual or autonomous policy run. Reviewer did not operate the original campaign. Reviewer authored part of the existing engine; independence here concerns reconstruction from another operator’s UI receipts, not original engine implementation.
method: Initialize the explicitly confirmed ASTERION-ODYSSEY-20 seed. Derive each ordinary command from the successful interaction’s actualControl attributes and the UI selection history. Selectors and intended action batches never override those receipts. Apply command/endTurn through archived source; no state edits. Check exact serialized JSON and command result after a JSON round trip before every next command, every actual exported state, and recorded visible observations.

limitations: Exact replay verifies the recorded campaign and export lineage; it does not assess whether a different strategy would win or attribute the victory to any individual AI change.
Visible-state responses are checked against the original driver’s recorded schema, not treated as independent proof that the entire UI disclosure policy is correct.
196 client checks and five explicit observations overlap; two checks cover the same unplayed default welcome. They are validation receipts, not 201 independent campaign samples.
No passive AI instrumentation, synthetic intervention fork, extra outcome cohort or new browser campaign was run for this report.
